prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a parking lot collision in Sugar Land, Texas, and has neck strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1369; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the parking lot collision you reported. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather just use my initials, if that's okay. I'm the driver of the blue sedan that was involved.

Q: That's fine. Can you describe where the collision took place?

A: It was in a shopping center parking lot in Sugar Land, Texas. I was pulling out of a parking space in one of the rows near the main entrance, going slowly, maybe five or ten miles an hour.

Q: What happened next?

A: A pickup truck was backing out of the space across from me. I didn't see it coming because a large SUV was parked on that side and blocked my view. The rear corner of the truck hit the front passenger side of my car.

Q: Did you have a chance to stop before impact?

A: I hit the brakes as soon as I saw the truck move, but there wasn't enough room to stop completely.

Q: Did you feel any injury at the scene?

A: Not right away. I felt fine for maybe an hour. Then my neck started to stiffen up, and by that evening I had a dull ache across the back of my shoulders and a headache that wouldn't go away.

Q: Have you sought medical attention since the collision?

A: Yes, I went to an urgent care clinic the next morning. They diagnosed me with a neck strain and gave me a muscle relaxer and told me to rest and use ice.

Q: Are you still experiencing symptoms?

A: Some days are better than others. Turning my head to the left is still painful, and I've had trouble sleeping.

Q: Thank you. Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: No, I think that covers it. I just want to get my car repaired and get back to normal.
